description: A PHP script implementing a remote execution server for testing purposes, providing methods to execute test cases and retrieve current time, utilizing the IXR XML-RPC library.

classes.name: IXR_Server
classes.description: External class used to create an XML-RPC server for handling remote method calls.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Handles different test case scenarios ('sayPassed', 'sayBlocked', 'sayFailed', 'sayScheduled') and returns corresponding result arrays with status and timestamp.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the current server time in HH:MM:SS format.
